text_block_list.text:
At last, it's time for Hishi Amazon's 
Debut Race.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Just thinking that the Twinkle Series' 
insane one-on-one showdowns start here 
gives me...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I just couldn't help shouting out loud!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
No, which is precisely why I need to 
settle things decisively today.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Getting caught sleeping at the start and 
looked down on is totally lame! Right, 
Trainee-boy?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, now that's what I call a great 
response! All right, make sure you keep 
right up with me!
